archival_memory.shipping_info: Shipping times vary based on inventory and location. Typically, orders are processed within 2-3 business days, and shipping takes an additional 5-7 business days. Expedited shipping is available for an additional fee.
archival_memory.shipping_policies: We offer free standard shipping on orders over $200. Expedited shipping is available for an additional fee, which varies based on the item and location.
archival_memory.tracking_info: Yes, you can track your order in real time once it's shipped. We'll provide you with a tracking number and a link to the carrier's website, where you can monitor the progress of your shipment.
archival_memory.return_exchange_policy: We offer a hassle-free return and exchange policy. If you need to return or exchange an item, you won't be charged for shipping. We'll provide a return shipping label and handle the exchange process smoothly.
